blockingFindings.title: Spec test imports missing recovery module
blockingFindings.issue: The new R13 spec-local test imports `../../../src/flow/lib/review-provider-recovery.js`, but this implementation does not add that touched production file and the module is not present in the workspace. The coverage artifact cannot load, so it does not prove the R13 recovery behavior.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Either add the missing `src/flow/lib/review-provider-recovery.js` implementation/export used by `review-provider-recovery.test.js`, or update the test to exercise the actual existing recovery surface for R13.
blockingFindings.rationale: T-5 requires spec-local tests proving the new behavior. A spec-local test with an unresolved static import is unusable coverage for R13 and blocks the mandatory acceptance requirement.
